Brazil wins its 1853 conflict with New Granada inside the Brazilian state of Amazonas (6,010 cells; 741 of the 766 conflict cells, -70.1 to -65.7 E, -3.2 to 2.0 N). Amazonas page: 'the Province of Amazonas was officially created by Emperor Pedro II in 1850'; the comarca of Rio Negro was in Pará, incorporated in the Empire in 1824; 'In 1761, a fort was built' at São Gabriel da Cachoeira; borders 'still undefined' after 1822 until the 1908 Vásquez Cobo-Martins treaty. The page gives no 1853 event, and the why says so honestly. Trial: settled 741 cell-years; the 741 cells are Brazil's 1853-1859; 25 Colombian cells (Vaupés/Guainía) stay nobody's from 1853 as both keyframes draw them. Nothing else changes.
